prompt:
Native pixel-art sprite correction, TIFA LOCKHART original FINAL FANTASY VII (1997), matching the attached sprite reference exactly: long flowing dark brown hair tied at end, white sleeveless top, black suspenders and short black skirt, red martial-arts gloves and red boots. Adult proportions, same crisp detailed pixel rendering. UNARMED, no sword, gun or props. Transparent RGBA background, no floor, shadow, labels, grid, text or effects.
ONE HORIZONTAL ROW of EXACTLY FOUR full-body sprites, equally spaced in FOUR equal cells. Wide landscape 4:1 canvas if possible, ideally1024x256. FRAME2: visibly deeper symmetric squat, both knees bend far outward, both fists pulled into a compact guard against the ribs with elbows tucked, head lower than frame1.

FRAME4: weight draws back again, knees staggered at different heights, elbows rise outward while both fists stay next to cheeks, torso more upright, ready to cycle to frame1.
Use actual anatomical changes of hips, shoulders, bent elbows and knees. All four poses are DISTINCT HOLDING/BRACING postures, not four stages of releasing a punch. Long hair follows the different torso angles. Keep consistent character size and sole baseline. No motion trail fragments and no disconnected pixels between sprites. These are newly drawn adapted game poses, not official FFVII frames.
